name: one word changes, one matching card follows
looks: The radar field stays faintly visible in the background throughout. A short headline's last word swaps across three beats, signal, then prospect, then message, and each time a different UI card appears beside it: a detected lead with a reason, a scored prospect profile, a drafted outreach message ready to send.
build: The headline's final word swaps on a hard cut with a quick scale/opacity snap, same mechanic as command-chip-cycle; the matching card fades/rises in beside it on each swap (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic), replacing the previous card entirely rather than stacking.
sound: A soft chime per word swap and a light pop as each card lands.
prompt: Swap a headline's last word across three beats while a matching UI card appears beside it each time, a detected signal, a scored prospect, a drafted message, so each word is proven by a different piece of the product rather than just stated.
